issues.detail: SI comparison Table S3 calls 4 ent-15beta,16beta-epoxide, but procedures call alpha,alpha. Source p50 draws 30 epoxide opposite to p49. C15/C16 epoxide stereo and 31 C15 are unresolved; not complete stereo training records.
C3 hydroxyl/thiocarbonyl relative configuration is not asserted from ambiguous chair bonds; requires independent review.
issues.subject: S21/S22/S25/28/29

issues.detail: No asymmetric reagent before S9-catalyzed step, yet S8 rotation and single-wedge depiction are supplied. S8 retained with unknown stereochemistry.
issues.subject: S8

issues.detail: Scheme writes er=89.6%, HPLC says 89.6:10.4; text calls (-)-15 while measured rotation listed +98.3. Use er ratio and source drawing, not sign-inferred absolute configuration.

SI p52 heading/prose erroneously call final hydrolysis an epoxide/compound4. Diagram, formula and characterization identify keto-diol acid5; no Na+ included in neutral acid recovered after acidic workup.
SI p52 labels [M+Na]+ for C21H33NaO5 at365.2323; formula/mass inconsistent. Neutral C21H32O5 topology from source is retained; no erroneous formula enforced.
p31 calls S18 feed16; p50 calls epoxide30 feed31. Diagrams resolve identifiers.
Scheme vs experimental temperatures/solvents differ: S8 alkylation60 vs50C, 15 cyclization MeCN50 vsDMSO40C, S2 displacement80 vs50C. Experimental conditions retained.
